objective: Feature parity across every non-gold feature event; a medal requires accepted frontend behavior, not engine capability alone.

features.name: Seekbar thumbnail previews
features.acceptance: Accepted after a Windows desktop UI smoke on 2026-11-26 using a generated local AVC clip in PR #37's exact build (head 748ca7d). Pointer hover at two timeline positions displayed distinct preview frames labeled 00:01 and 00:02 while playback stayed paused at 00:03. A left click then sought to 00:02.13. The smoke verified preview positioning, pointer updates, no seek on hover, and seek on click in the actual desktop frontend. PR #23 implementation uses a separate paused libmpv client, 16 MiB bounded GPU LRU cache, coalesced requests, keyboard support and accessibility. Slint eligibility tests, real-media compositor pixel/bucket checks, and all seven exact-head hosted workflows passed. This acceptance covers Windows desktop behavior; hosted cross-platform tests cover the other builds.

features.name: Native picture in picture
features.acceptance: The base implementation is merged in PR #22: a compact always-on-top window with Play/Pause, Return and Close, preserving the prior size, position and window modes. Draft PR #36 (head 1afdbf9) keeps the main player at its original size while opening PiP independently, copies and updates live frames and media state, clears stale frames for audio-only media or changed playback, forwards transport actions to the shared player callback, and keeps the View menu synchronized on Return/Close. Red/green UI tests cover the separate window lifecycle, copied/updated frames, current title/paused/status state, routed pause, hide/show, Return and menu state. All seven hosted checks passed on 1afdbf9: Code, Desktop UI, native helper, CodSpeed, Native controls, Windows packaging and Video compositor. Physical focus, multi-display behavior and GPU texture presentation remain unverified; do not close this gap or claim a medal.

features.name: Gapless audio playback
features.acceptance: Implementation is in draft PR #26 at current head c5b5181. Queued playlists, automatic advancement, queue retention on Stop, native PCM capture, and hosted virtual PulseAudio loopback are implemented. All seven exact-head hosted workflows passed: Code, Desktop UI, native helper, Windows packaging, Native playback controls, Video compositor, and CodSpeed. A clean Windows worktree passed all 29 desktop UI binary tests; exact-head workspace coverage passed at 93.51% (3,835/4,101). CodSpeed reports 36 improved, 32 regressed, and 211 unchanged, but 68 significant comparisons used different hardware, so the comparison is not reliable. All six load_confirmation cases still report 39.33% slower (171.9 ns to 283.3 ns); this regression is unresolved and no aggregate gain is claimed. Physical multi-track listening and Previous/Next acceptance remain pending; do not close this gap or claim a medal.

features.name: DVD / Blu-ray structure playback
features.acceptance: Implementation is in draft PR #31 at ce45782: DVD/Blu-ray folder and ISO selection, structure/signature validation, disc-menu navigation, and a dispatch-path performance follow-up. All seven current-head hosted checks passed; CodSpeed reported no measured change in its comparable cases. Hosted tests exercised a generated unencrypted DVD ISO, not commercial discs. The Windows release workflow installs only the libmpv runtime; it does not package libdvdnav, libdvdread, or libbluray. VideoLAN documents libdvdnav/libdvdread as GPL-licensed and libbluray as LGPL; this records upstream licensing information, not a distribution-compliance determination. libbluray alone does not support AACS/BD+ protected commercial discs. Packaged navigation runtime, license/compliance decision, Blu-ray media, physical drives, and real-disc playback remain pending. Do not close this gap or claim a medal.

features.name: Chromecast video output
features.acceptance: Pinned transport, restricted file serving and owned playback APIs pass real TLS/HTTP fixtures. Owner-confirmed silent H.264 playback and pause/seek/resume/stop passed on two receivers during a 30-second window. The desktop Cast menu supports manual local-address entry, bounded in-app certificate inspection, explicit pin review, opt-in bounded mDNS discovery, worker controls and loaded local media with supported audio containers. Remember/forget for up to 32 explicitly reviewed local receiver pins is implemented in local user preferences. Physical desktop UI/discovery use and audio playback remain unverified; codecs beyond tested H.264 remain unverified. No casting gold is claimed.

features.name: Search and download subtitles
features.acceptance: Implementation is in draft PR #41 at head 146ff10: a desktop Subtitles dialog searches OpenSubtitles by language, downloads validated SRT/ASS/SSA/WebVTT beside the current local media, and adds it to playback. The API key stays in session memory; provider requests and downloads are bounded, cancellable, and HTTPS-only. Authenticated curl calls no longer follow redirects, and the regression test proved RED with redirect-following enabled and GREEN after removal, preventing API-key forwarding; unauthenticated subtitle-file downloads retain redirect handling. Provider and desktop callback tests, 96.54% subtitle-module line coverage, 100% function coverage, and strict workspace Clippy passed locally. Exact-head hosted checks are queued/running. Live account/provider behavior and visible playback against a real media file remain pending; no medal is claimed.

features.name: Touch or trackpad playback gestures
features.acceptance: The desktop video surface maps horizontal trackpad scrolling and horizontal touch drags to bounded relative seeks, and vertical scrolling/drags to volume. The software-window UI test covers 31px/32px drag thresholds, seek direction and ±15s clamps, volume 0–100 clamps, trackpad scrolling, and disabled playback state. Physical trackpad/touchscreen validation remains before acceptance; no feature medal is claimed. A Windows development-build smoke on 2026-11-26 loaded a generated H.264 clip: a 40 px horizontal drag from 0 s moved playback to 2 s; a 40 px downward drag changed volume 100→95; injected horizontal scrolling moved 2.97→1.97 s, and vertical scrolling changed volume 95→97.5. These were software mouse/scroll injections, not physical trackpad or touchscreen tests; those remain pending.

features.name: System media-control integration
features.acceptance: The shared playwire adapter connects Windows SMTC, macOS Now Playing, and Linux MPRIS. At merged PR #13 head e403070, all seven hosted checks passed, including the 90% full desktop/GPU coverage gate. Focused local Windows verification passed all 8 system-media tests and the full 31-test player-ui suite; strict UI Clippy passed with existing legacy-lint exceptions. Local default-workspace coverage was 93.64% (3,722/3,975 lines), but excludes feature-gated desktop/GPU code and is not a substitute for the hosted combined gate. On draft PR #38 head 7956695, Native playback controls run 45539812607 passed the real private-D-Bus MPRIS test: status, title/artist/album, transport capabilities, path privacy, and Play/Pause/PlayPause/Next/Previous/Seek routing were verified. CodSpeed, compositor, Windows packaging, and helper checks also passed on that head. The rustfmt-only correction is in a8c0174. All seven exact-head checks then passed: Code 45541566809, Desktop UI 45541566801, Native playback controls 45541566889, helper 45541566854, compositor 45541566786, Windows packaging 45541566795, and CodSpeed 45541566845. Physical session interaction and user-visible behavior on Windows, macOS, and Linux remain unverified; do not close the gap or claim a medal.

features.name: HD audio bitstream passthrough
features.acceptance: Implementation is in draft PR #27 at c1869a2: a session-only desktop control requests AC3, EAC3, DTS, DTS-HD, and TrueHD with exclusive output, and can disable passthrough. All seven current-head hosted checks passed. Exact-head CodSpeed run 45459095782 reports 3 improved and 276 unchanged benchmarks, with no measured regressions; five optimized-out and one syscall-dominated case were excluded. This replaces the earlier 13.95% aggregate improvement claim; no aggregate performance claim is made. CI does not verify bitstream output. A compatible physical receiver/route must identify each claimed format with audible output, and decoded output must still work when passthrough is disabled. Do not close this gap or claim a medal.

features.name: Stereoscopic 3D video
features.acceptance: Draft PR #32 at a25b7cb adds opt-in stereoscopic source/output modes with a labeled FFmpeg stereo3d filter. A red/green follow-up routes Stereo 3D through a dedicated VideoControl path instead of generic PlaybackControl dispatch. Tests first failed because that route did not exist; a second regression caught invalid direct enum values panicking, now safely ignored. The full desktop player-ui suite passed locally (50 tests), and formatting/whitespace checks passed. Current CodSpeed run 45517807720 reports no measured change across 279 benchmarks; five optimized-out and two syscall-dominated cases are excluded. Windows packaging passed; Code, Desktop UI, Native controls, native helper, and compositor are queued. Physical stereoscopic display acceptance remains pending; do not close this gap or claim a medal.

features.name: Skip detected episode intros
features.acceptance: Implementation and tests are in draft PR #29 at 6a75f8b. Bounded chapter-title seeking and asynchronous IntroDB lookup validate explicit IMDb/season/episode tags, response identity, size, marker boundaries, confidence, cancellation, stale results, and seek bounds. A red/green regression now ensures a lookup finishing after playback stops cannot re-enable Skip Intro. The exact-head hosted runs all passed: Code checks (45544045194), Desktop UI (45544045300), Native playback controls (45544045294), CodSpeed (45544045280), Windows packaging (45544045367), Video compositor (45544045297), and native helper (45544045209). The live IntroDB check verified a valid no-marker response, not an available skip segment. Physical episode playback and visible Skip Intro interaction remain pending; do not close this gap or claim a medal.
